topic: When to Reinvest Profit vs When to Use Finance
objective: Give a balanced framework for choosing between self-funding and external finance.

slides.headline: When to Reinvest Profit vs When to Use Finance
slides.subheadline: Both have a place — the question is timing.

slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: Reinvesting profit keeps a business debt-free, but it can slow growth to the pace of what's already been earned. Finance can accelerate a well-timed opportunity, at the cost of repayments. Weighing speed against cost — for each specific decision — usually beats a blanket rule either way.

caption:
Neither reinvesting profit nor using finance is universally "better" — they suit different situations. Reinvestment keeps things simple and debt-free but moves at the pace of what's already been earned; finance can move faster but comes with a cost and a repayment commitment.

The more useful approach is weighing each significant decision on its own merits, rather than defaulting to one path every time.
